svg.data-input-ac: 100/120 to 240 V single-phase, 16 A maximum (agency de-rated to 16 A continuous in North America), 50/60 Hz
svg.data-capacity-scope: the load the PDU can hand on, 3.84 kW at 240 V down to 1.92 kW at 120 V, 16 A in all (spec sheet). It is not what the PDU draws itself, which no document held states
svg.data-output-rating: 16 A total; 16 A max per C19; 12 A (10 A CE) max per C13

g.data-description: the IEC C20 power inlet; no cord is supplied, and it takes a user cord with a C19 connector
g.title: input

g.data-description: the upper 16 A push-to-reset breaker; what it protects is not stated
g.title: breaker-1

g.data-description: the lower 16 A push-to-reset breaker; what it protects is not stated
g.title: breaker-2
